import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int[][] DIRECTIONS = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};
    static final int MAXN = 20;
    static final int MAXNODES = 1000;
    static final int MAXEDGES = 1000000;

    static int S, T, total_edges = 1, grid_size, time_limit, INF, head[];
    static int edge_tail[], edge_cap[], edge_next[];
    static int sink_nodes[][] = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int dist[][] = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int dep_map[][] = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int node_id[][] = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char grid_a[][] = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char grid_b[][] = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int queue_bfs[] = new int[MAXNODES * 1000];
    static int depth_arr[] = new int[MAXNODES];

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        edge_tail[total_edges] = v;
        edge_cap[total_edges] = cap;
        edge_next[total_edges] = head[u];
        head[u] = total_edges++;
        
        edge_tail[total_edges] = u;
        edge_cap[total_edges] = 0;
        edge_next[total_edges] = head[v];
        head[v] = total_edges++;
    }

    static void bfs_search(int x0, int y0, boolean is_build_phase) {
        int l = 0, r = 0;
        queue_bfs[r++] = x0 * 1000 + y0;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; j++) {
                dist[i][j] = 0x3f3f3f3f;
            }
        }
        INF = dist[0][0];
        dist[x0][y0] = 0;
        
        while (l < r) {
            int x = queue_bfs[l] / 1000;
            int y = queue_bfs[l++] % 1000;
            
            if (is_build_phase && sink_nodes[x][y] != 0 && dist[x][y] <= time_limit && dist[x][y] <= dep_map[x][y]) {
                add_edge(node_id[x][y], sink_nodes[x][y], INF);
            }
            
            if (dist[x][y] > time_limit || dist[x][y] >= dep_map[x][y]) continue;
            
            if (node_id[x][y] == 3 && sink_nodes[x][y] == 9) {
                System.out.println(dist[x][y]);
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + DIRECTIONS[i][0];
                int ny = y + DIRECTIONS[i][1];
                if (nx > 0 && nx <= grid_size && ny > 0 && ny <= grid_size && Character.isDigit(grid_a[nx][ny]) && dist[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                    queue_bfs[r++] = nx * 1000 + ny;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean level_graph_build() {
        Arrays.fill(depth_arr, 0);
        int l = 0, r = 0;
        queue_bfs[r++] = S;
        depth_arr[S] = 1;
        
        while (l < r) {
            int u = queue_bfs[l++];
            for (int e = head[u]; e != 0; e = edge_next[e]) {
                int v = edge_tail[e];
                if (depth_arr[v] != 0 && edge_cap[e] != 0) continue;
                depth_arr[v] = depth_arr[u] + 1;
                queue_bfs[r++] = v;
                if (v == T) return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dfs_flow(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == T) return flow;
        int pushed = 0;
        for (int e = head[u]; e != 0 && flow - pushed > 0; e = edge_next[e]) {
            int v = edge_tail[e];
            if (depth_arr[v] != depth_arr[u] + 1 || edge_cap[e] == 0) continue;
            int f = dfs_flow(v, Math.min(flow - pushed, edge_cap[e]));
            pushed += f;
            edge_cap[e] -= f;
            edge_cap[e ^ 1] += f;
        }
        if (pushed == 0) depth_arr[u] = -1;
        return pushed;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        grid_size = scanner.nextInt();
        time_limit = scanner.nextInt();
        
        scanner.nextLine(); // consume newline
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_size; i++) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            grid_a[i] = new char[MAXN];
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; j++) {
                grid_a[i][j] = (j < line.length()) ? line.charAt(j) : ' ';
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_size; i++) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            grid_b[i] = new char[MAXN];
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; j++) {
                grid_b[i][j] = (j < line.length()) ? line.charAt(j) : ' ';
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; j++) {
                dep_map[i][j] = 0x3f3f3f3f;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_size; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= grid_size; j++) {
                if (grid_a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    bfs_search(i, j, false);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(dist[i], 0, dep_map[i], 0, MAXN);
        }
        
        int node_count = 1;
        S = 0;
        T = 1;
        
        head = new int[MAXNODES];
        edge_tail = new int[MAXEDGES];
        edge_cap = new int[MAXEDGES];
        edge_next = new int[MAXEDGES];
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_size; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= grid_size; j++) {
                if (grid_a[i][j] > '0' && grid_a[i][j] <= '9') {
                    node_id[i][j] = ++node_count;
                    add_edge(S, node_id[i][j], grid_a[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (grid_b[i][j] > '0' && grid_b[i][j] <= '9') {
                    sink_nodes[i][j] = ++node_count;
                    add_edge(sink_nodes[i][j], T, grid_b[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_size; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= grid_size; j++) {
                if (node_id[i][j] != 0) {
                    bfs_search(i, j, true);
                }
            }
        }
        
        int max_flow = 0;
        while (level_graph_build()) {
            max_flow += dfs_flow(S, INF);
        }
        
        System.out.println(max_flow);
    }
}
